methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
The ECLAC (CEPAL) Digital Repository at repositorio.cepal.org is a DSpace 7 institutional repository holding the publications of the UN Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean: books, conference contributions, book chapters, articles, serials and reports (7,757 hits on a 'poverty' query). Content is largely bilingual/trilingual (Spanish, English, French, Portuguese). No authentication is required for reads.

## Search
Use the DSpace Discovery API (preferred over OAI-PMH, which is harvest-only and has no keyword search). GET `https://repositorio.cepal.org/server/api/discover/search/objects` with `query=<terms>`, `dsoType=item`, `page` (0-based), `size`, and `sort` (e.g. `dc.date.issued,DESC`). Items sit under `_embedded.searchResult._embedded.objects[]._embedded.indexableObject` with `uuid`, `name` and a `metadata` map; total at `_embedded.searchResult.page.totalElements`.

## Filters
Apply DSpace facets as `f.<facet>=<value>,equals`. Verified facets and values: `f.typedoc` (document type; Spanish labels: libro, contribución a congreso, capítulo de libro, artículo, publicación seriada, video, informe), `f.language` (spa, eng, fra, por, mul), `f.dateIssued=[YYYY TO YYYY],equals` (date range). The API exposes 27 facets total, including `unsymbol` (UN document symbol), `sdg`, `regionaloffice`, `series`, `publisher`, `project`, `coverageEng`/`coverageSpa`, `subjectEng`/`subjectSpa`.

## Download
PDFs are DSpace bitstreams. Chain: `GET /server/api/core/items/{uuid}/bundles` -> pick `ORIGINAL` -> `GET /server/api/core/bundles/{bundleUuid}/bitstreams` -> follow `_links.content.href` (`/server/api/core/bitstreams/{uuid}/content`). Verified resolution on a sample item to LCcarG555_en.pdf.

## Metadata & Enrichment
`GET /server/api/core/items/{uuid}` returns the full Dublin Core block: `dc.identifier.uri` (Handle), `dc.type.coar`, `dc.language.iso`, `dc.publisher`, `dc.format.mimetype`, `dc.coverage.spatialEng` (country), plus the UN symbol via the `unsymbol` index. The `TEXT` bundle provides machine-extracted full text.

## Limitations
WebFetch succeeds here (no aggressive WAF), unlike WHO IRIS. Facet labels for document type are Spanish only. OAI-PMH exists at `https://repositorio.cepal.org/server/oai/request` but supports only bulk harvesting by set/date, not keyword queries — keep it as a bulk-sync fallback, not the primary search path.
